answer.reason: Based on BLS QCEW fourth-quarter 2024 data for Washington, the December 2024 private-sector covered employment level for NAICS 54 (Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services) is 253,782 covered jobs.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In the BLS QCEW fourth-quarter 2024 data for Washington, what was the December 2024 private-sector employment level, in covered jobs, for NAICS 54 Professional, scientific, and technical services?

A. 253,782 covered jobs
B. 208,942 covered jobs

Source citation: BLS QCEW Open Data, Washington statewide, 2024 Q4 (https://data.bls.gov/cew/data/api/2024/4/area/53000.csv)
